channel.description: Guides on certified translation, uncontested divorce, powers of attorney and other documents, written in plain language for families in the U.S.

item.title: Certified Translation for USCIS: What It Is and What It Must Include
item.description: What USCIS expects from a certified translation, how it differs from a notarized or sworn translation, and how to avoid the mistakes that delay a case.

item.title: Power of Attorney for Brazil: Notarization and Apostille Explained

item.title: Uncontested Divorce: The Documents to Gather Before You Start
item.description: A plain-language checklist of the information and documents you need for an uncontested divorce, and the points both spouses must agree on first.
